text: 从业内获悉，金融管理部门11月2日将召开会议。有证券公司、基金公司接到通知，11月2日中国人民银行、中国证监会召开会议，研究推动支持资本市场工具使用。同一天，中国人民银行、金融监管总局、中国证监会还将召集各大银行开会研究优化股票回购增持再贷款政策。
text_en: Sources in the industry indicated that financial regulators will hold a meeting on November 2. Some securities firms and fund companies received notices that the PBOC and the CSRC will convene a meeting on November 2 to study ways to promote the use of tools supporting the capital market. On the same day, the PBOC, the National Financial Regulatory Administration and the CSRC will also convene a meeting with major banks to study optimizing the relending policy for stock buybacks and increased shareholdings.
